classes.meaning: One value is present in every eligible record with no missingness.
One value is present in at least 70 percent of eligible records without an earlier class applying.
Multiple lawful values are observed without exact logical-exclusivity proof.
Identity-like or otherwise highly varied values exceed the frozen cardinality rule.
Present and explicitly missing observations coexist.
At least two values conflict under one exact versioned exclusivity rule and scope.
One value is present in at least 20 percent but less than 70 percent of eligible records.
The component is present in fewer than 20 percent of eligible records.
